Annotation Interface EnableSpringConfigured

@Target(TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented @Import(SpringConfiguredConfiguration.class) public @interface EnableSpringConfigured
Signals the current application context to apply dependency injection to non-managed classes that are instantiated outside the Spring bean factory (typically classes annotated with the @Configurable annotation).

类似于 Spring 的 `` XML 元素中的功能。通常与 @EnableLoadTimeWeaving 配合使用。
